name: Olivia Ferro
profile: British entrepreneur who co-founded SheMed in 2024 with her sister Chloe Ferro and leads it as CEO. SheMed is a UK clinician-led digital weight-management and metabolic-health service for women (GLP-1 programmes, advanced blood testing, PMOS/PCOS screening, supplements) that says it has served 100,000+ women; the sisters say they set out to build the healthcare they wished had existed for them.
interesting_fact: SheMed partnered with University College London (led by Prof. John Deanfield) on one of the largest real-world studies of GLP-1 treatment in women: 8,000+ patients, 91.4% six-month retention and 15.5% average weight loss.
notes: Her founding story is published by SheMed itself (https://www.shemed.co.uk/blog/weight-loss/olivias-personal-journey-with-pcos-and-glp-1-medications), but it is a personal health story, so it is not used as a deep-cut fact.
